Subject:

Evaluation of Borgwaldt Firmness Tester

The evaluation of the Borgwaldt Firmness Tester will determine:

- 1) If the Borgwaldt unit is as sensitive to cigarette firmness as the standard PM compacimer,
- 2) If the variability of the Borgwaldt instrument is comparable to that of the PM compacimeter,
- 3) If the Borgwaldt unit is unduly sensitive to other cigarette characteristics such as circumference or seam orientation, and
- 4) If the unit is easier to operate, set-up and maintain than the standard PM compacimeter.

The sensitivity and variability of the Borgwaldt unit will be determined by testing cigarettes of a single blend at five different. weit  t t tt  t   o te Thorr   rt r       iure the accuracy of the results. Cigarettes will also be tested at two circumference levels and five weight levels to determine the sensitivity of the Borgwaldt unit to circumference variation. In addition, a set of cigarettes will be tested with three different seam orientations to determine the sensitivity of Borgwaldt firmness results to seam position. Th t  t  tn    t t tsitiv  t   tt  t  t t re with the PM compacimeter.
